accept.title: One thing before you start
accept.subtitle: Your account was created through your identity provider, so you haven't seen these yet. Have a read, then agree to carry on.

cookies.label: About cookies and browser storage
cookies.title: A quick word about cookies
cookies.body: {{appName}} keeps a few things in this browser: what keeps you signed in, the theme you picked, what you had open. That's the lot — no advertising, no analytics, and nothing following you around other sites.
cookies.spamCheck: The sign-up form loads a spam check from {{provider}}, which sets a cookie of its own while you're on it.
